task: Reconcile Stage 1 MR1 workforce identity by converging alternate platform, template-preview and workforce invite authentication continuations onto the canonical workforce login authority without activating AAL2 enforcement.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: The transaction removes alternate privileged authentication continuations across platform, Builder preview and invitation onboarding. A mistake could mix shopper/workforce authentication, enable an alternate password entry, create an unsafe redirect, or make an invite unusable. Canonical Supabase identity, server-side role authority and the parked AAL2 enforcement must remain unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria: The dedicated /api/auth/workforce-login page and WorkforceAuthForm are the only password-login/recovery entry surface used to begin privileged workforce/admin access.

The active /platform portal no longer exposes or imports the legacy direct-password PlatformAuthForm; existing workforce users enter through the canonical workforce login while first-owner activation is provided by a canonical auth-owned activation component.
Template-preview authentication no longer renders the customer AuthForm and delegates only to the canonical workforce login with a sanitized exact preview return target.
Explicit /fiokom workforce login intent bridges both admin and exact template-preview return targets before storefront instance resolution while ordinary shopper authentication remains unchanged.

Workforce invitations and password recovery complete credential establishment on a workforce-owned route and then continue into the canonical workforce login; the customer account AuthForm is not used for workforce onboarding or recovery.
Return targets accept only local /admin, /admin/* and exact /storefront-template-preview targets; protocol-relative, external, customer-account and preview-login loop targets are rejected.
No role, tenant, middleware authorization authority or AAL2 enforcement is added, weakened or activated.
invariants: Supabase Auth remains the only session/password/MFA authority.
Server-owned platform_operators and role_bindings authorities remain unchanged.
Customer AuthForm remains shopper-only and is not imported by workforce-only entry routes.
Workforce return-target sanitization is shared and fail closed.
The parked PR #858 is not merged, rebased or modified by this release unit.
No first-tenant, first-membership or audit-login bypass is introduced.

failureModes: The platform page keeps a direct signInWithPassword branch, leaving a privileged alternate entrypoint.
The preview login continues to use customer AuthForm, allowing workforce authentication to traverse customer UX.
A broad prefix check accepts /storefront-template-preview-login or a crafted protocol-relative URL and causes loops or open redirects.
An invited merchant owner/admin receives a workforce membership but must use shopper account onboarding to establish a password.
Post-activation navigation jumps directly to /admin/platform instead of traversing canonical workforce context/MFA UX.
The change accidentally activates the parked AAL2 authorization enforcement or changes RBAC/tenant authority.
Removing the legacy platform login also removes the only visible workforce password-recovery path, forcing privileged users back through shopper recovery UX.
edgeCases: next=/admin and nested admin URLs with query strings are preserved.
Exact /storefront-template-preview with query parameters is preserved.
An existing customer session reaching workforce login can sign out and choose another account rather than being treated as workforce.
An invite link with a valid Supabase session can set a password then continue to workforce login without creating a new session authority.
A platform activation that already returns a session continues through workforce login rather than directly entering admin.
A workforce password-recovery link establishes a new password through the workforce credential route and then re-enters canonical workforce context/MFA processing.

alternatives.summary: Keep /platform and preview customer-style password login surfaces and rely only on downstream admin authorization.
alternatives.reason: This preserves split workforce authentication entrypoints and makes MFA/workforce UX bypassable before the parked server enforcement is activated.

alternatives.summary: Teach middleware to classify platform/preview/invite users and force the right login surface.
alternatives.reason: Middleware is intentionally a coarse prefilter and must not become role/authentication workflow authority.

alternatives.summary: Keep activation/invite completion narrowly scoped, but delegate all privileged login continuations to the existing dedicated workforce login and one shared return-target sanitizer.
alternatives.reason: This removes duplicate login authority while preserving Supabase Auth, existing server RBAC/tenant truth and the parked AAL2 enforcement boundary.

specialistReviews.finding: Privileged entrypoints must converge on DOMAIN-IDENTITY rather than letting platform, storefront or Builder presentation own login policy.
specialistReviews.resolution: Platform and Builder surfaces become thin delegators; workforce session/password/MFA primitives stay under the existing auth authority.

specialistReviews.finding: Simply redirecting platform/preview login is insufficient if workforce invitations still establish credentials through the shopper account flow or if return-target matching is prefix-based.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add a workforce-owned invite completion route and exact-path return sanitizer; deterministic tests reject loop/external/customer targets.

specialistReviews.finding: The release must not turn the parked #858 server AAL2 enforcement on during ongoing visual/functional audits.
specialistReviews.resolution: No #858 branch file or assurance-enforcement code is changed; this unit only removes alternate login/onboarding entry surfaces.

challenge.scenario: A user opens /platform with an existing platform account.
challenge.finding: The current form calls signInWithPassword and reaches /admin/platform without the dedicated workforce login.
challenge.resolution: Remove platform direct password login and expose canonical workforce login as the only existing-account entry.

challenge.scenario: An unauthenticated owner opens a template preview deep link.
challenge.finding: The current preview login renders customer AuthForm even though authorization is workforce-only.
challenge.resolution: The preview login validates provenance parameters then redirects to canonical workforce login with the exact preview target.

challenge.scenario: A platform-created merchant owner/admin accepts an invite.
challenge.finding: The redirect currently lands on /fiokom invite UX, mixing workforce onboarding with customer account authentication.
challenge.resolution: Use a dedicated workforce invite completion route that only establishes the Supabase password and then hands off to canonical workforce login.

challenge.scenario: An attacker supplies //evil.example, /fiokom or /storefront-template-preview-login as next.
challenge.finding: Broad local-prefix logic can create open redirect or authentication-loop behavior.
challenge.resolution: A shared sanitizer parses against a fixed local origin and allowlists exact workforce-owned path families only.

challenge.scenario: The convergence work is mistaken for permission/MFA enforcement and modifies requireAdmin, middleware or tenant resolution.
challenge.finding: Scope expansion could activate #858 semantics or create a second authority.
challenge.resolution: Those authorities remain impacted-read-only; tests explicitly prohibit AAL2 enforcement and customer AuthForm coupling in this unit.

challenge.scenario: The legacy PlatformAuthForm remains in the repository after the active /platform route is moved to a canonical auth-owned activation component.
challenge.finding: Dead legacy source could be mistaken for a still-supported authentication authority or be accidentally re-imported later.
challenge.resolution: The active /platform route must not import PlatformAuthForm, source-level regression proves zero active route reference, and the legacy file remains read-only in this transaction because its path is not Atlas-classified. Removing/classifying dead code is not allowed to widen this MR1 release unit.

challenge.scenario: The legacy platform form is removed from the active route and a workforce user forgets their password.
challenge.finding: Without moving recovery into the canonical workforce form, the user would either lose recovery or be forced through the shopper AuthForm, recreating the customer/workforce split violation.
challenge.resolution: WorkforceAuthForm initiates Supabase password recovery and the workforce-owned credential completion route updates the password, then delegates back to workforce login/context/MFA.

proofPlan: Run Plan Before Code on the exact plan-only head and do not edit implementation until PASS.
Add deterministic return-target and source-contract regression tests covering platform, preview, invite and shopper-isolation paths.
Run Edit-Time / Reference Sync and Incremental Known Failure Replay after the coherent implementation batch.
Run full Quality Tests, TypeScript and Production Build.
Require exact-head Completion Truth VERIFIED and lifecycle closure before merge.

requirements.requirement: All privileged workforce login and invitation continuations converge on workforce-owned Supabase Auth UX with safe local return targets, while shopper authentication, server RBAC/tenant authority and parked AAL2 enforcement remain separate and unchanged.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Platform and Builder preview surfaces must not retain a separate privileged signInWithPassword/customer AuthForm path.
Workforce invitation/login completion must not require shopper account AuthForm semantics.
Workforce continuation targets must remain local and limited to admin or exact template-preview routes.
This release must not merge, weaken or activate the parked AAL2 authorization enforcement.

notes: MR1 reconciliation found active non-canonical privileged entrypoints on main: /platform direct password login, template-preview customer AuthForm login, and workforce invite completion through /fiokom. This is one release unit to converge entrypoints only. PR #858 remains parked and untouched. Plan Before Code attempt 1 correctly blocked because src/components/auth/platform-auth-form.tsx is not Atlas-classified and high-risk challenge depth was 5/6. The remediation does not weaken Atlas: the active /platform route moves to a canonical src/lib/auth activation component, leaves the unclassified legacy file read-only/unreachable, and adds the missing adversarial challenge. Pre-implementation dependency review also found WorkforceAuthForm.finish() was admin-only and that platform-login removal would otherwise orphan workforce password recovery. The same release unit therefore centralizes allowed workforce return targets in WorkforceAuthForm and moves invite/recovery credential completion to an auth-owned route; customer AuthForm remains read-only.
